clue.text: Spend a lot of money on launch

definitions.meaning: an idiom for being lavish and splashing out on something
literally, shoving a vessel off into the water when launching it

explanation.surface: Someone splurges heavily on a product launch.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to be extravagant; taken literally it describes setting a vessel afloat.

clue.text: Clerk is becoming more smooth-tongued

indicators.note: becoming tells us the letters of the two words turn into something new

explanation.surface: An office clerk grows more glib.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becoming' rearranges CLERK and IS into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A slicker talker is glibber and more persuasive, a comparative adjective matching the clue.

clue.text: To leave the country

parts.note: to leave is to go away

explanation.surface: Someone means to emigrate.
explanation.definitionFit: Togo is a nation in West Africa.

clue.text: Trader was stout

parts.note: ex- means former, so it says something once was
porter is a dark beer similar to stout

explanation.surface: A merchant was once overweight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was stout' reads as former porter: EX (former) plus PORTER (a dark beer like stout).
explanation.definitionFit: Someone selling goods abroad is a kind of merchant.

clue.text: Having gin now shaken

indicators.note: shaken, like a cocktail, means the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone has a gin, shaken just now.
explanation.definitionFit: Possessing something is the same as having it.

clue.text: Becoming more dull like a mountain lake in Gabon?

parts.note: a tarn is a small mountain lake
the suffix -ish means like or somewhat
G is the international vehicle registration code for Gabon

explanation.surface: A question about whether a mountain lake in an African country is losing its shine.
explanation.walkthrough: TARN plus -ISH gives 'like a mountain lake'; then IN and G for Gabon.
explanation.definitionFit: Metal that loses its lustre and grows dull is said to be tarnishing.

clue.text: One making one

parts.note: a person who brings separate parts together into a single whole

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who unites things makes them into a single body.

clue.text: Remaining without food travelling to the country but not first of all

parts.note: travelling means going

indicators.note: but not tells us to drop a letter from the country's name

parts.note: Hungary is a central European country

indicators.note: first of picks out the opening letter of the word all

explanation.surface: Someone stays unfed while travelling to a country.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove A (first of 'all') from HUNGARY to leave HUNGRY; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay unfed is to go hungry, an idiom for starving.

clue.text: Spawning development of distance from one tip to another

definitions.text: distance from one tip to another

indicators.note: a development of a word turns its letters into something else

explanation.surface: Breeding fish leads to some kind of growth.
explanation.definitionFit: Wingspan is the measurement across a bird's or aircraft's outstretched wings.

clue.text: Money one charges

definitions.meaning: an animal known for charging at threats

explanation.definitionFit: Rhino is dated British slang for cash, and the horned beast is famous for charging.

clue.text: Char with marital problem concerning mother

indicators.note: a problem with the letters means they are in disarray and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A cleaning lady has trouble in her marriage involving her mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with ... problem' rearranges CHAR and MARITAL. A char is a British cleaning lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to a female head of a family is the meaning of this adjective.

clue.text: Frank hastily accepting cross

indicators.note: the words accept, or hold within them, the letters wanted

explanation.surface: Frank quickly agrees to a crucifix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepting' signals the letters held inside fr(ANK H)astily.
explanation.definitionFit: The ankh is an ancient Egyptian looped cross symbolising life.

clue.text: Change-over stage

definitions.meaning: a passage from one state to another

explanation.definitionFit: A move from one condition to another, or the intermediate phase of such a move.

clue.text: Port is repeatedly accepting credit during conflict

indicators.note: the port and repeated word take in the abbreviation between them

parts.note: Suez is an Egyptian port on the canal

indicators.note: repeatedly means the word is is used twice

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A port repeatedly takes credit in wartime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepting' puts the credit abbreviation between the port and the doubled word; 'during' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1956 Suez Crisis was an international conflict over the canal.

clue.text: Way when overdrawn to be redirected

indicators.note: when, as in 'way when overdrawn', means the way is in the red, placed inside it

parts.note: an overdrawn account is in the red
a route is a way

explanation.surface: A path is diverted because of an overdraft.
explanation.walkthrough: Being overdrawn is being 'in the red', so 'when' places the way inside that colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Sent by a different path means the same as rerouted.

clue.text: Chaplains going round old city place of worship

indicators.note: going round means the chaplains surround the city

parts.note: CH is an abbreviation for chaplain, so two chaplains give two of them
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city

explanation.surface: Chaplains tour an ancient city's holy place.
explanation.walkthrough: Ur was an ancient city in Mesopotamia; 'going round' has the two chaplains surround it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Christian building used for services.

clue.text: Trap everybody covering every eventuality

parts.note: to trap is to catch
everybody means all

explanation.surface: A snare for everyone that handles every case.
explanation.definitionFit: A catch-all clause or term is one designed to cover all cases.

clue.text: Burning a short coat

indicators.note: short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a blazer is a jacket

explanation.surface: Someone is hot in a little jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: On fire and aflame is a synonym.

clue.text: Chemical bond to be connected long time afterwards

parts.note: to link is to join or connect
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: A chemical bond forms connections long after.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry a linkage is the bond joining atoms or groups.

clue.text: Preserve crazy animation, not ordinary

indicators.note: crazy means the letters go wild and rearrange
not means a letter is to be left out of the word

explanation.surface: A cartoon is preserved in a crazy way, avoiding the normal.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove O from ANIMATION and rearrange ANIMATIN with 'crazy'.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep something going or in good condition is to sustain it.

clue.text: One expected to take flight

parts.note: reads as a coward expected to flee, but means someone whose job is flying

explanation.definitionFit: A pilot is expected to fly an aircraft.

clue.text: Not even numbers brought up for favourite

parts.note: odd means not even

indicators.note: brought up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Odd numbers raised for a favourite.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'brought up' turns the numbers abbreviation upward to read the other way.
explanation.definitionFit: In betting, a horse with odds shorter than evens is the favourite.

clue.text: Say the opposite when dianne is in agreement

indicators.note: is in means the name is placed inside the agreement

parts.note: a contract is a formal agreement
Di is a short form of the name Dianne

explanation.surface: Someone disagrees when Dianne signs a deal.
explanation.walkthrough: Dianne shortens to the pet name Di; 'is in' puts it inside the agreement, and 'when' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To deny or assert the reverse of a statement.

clue.text: Storyteller found wader on the way back

indicators.note: on the way back means the bird's name is read backwards

parts.note: a rail is a wading marsh bird

explanation.surface: A raconteur spots a wading bird on the return trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A storyteller is a jocular term for someone who tells untruths.

clue.text: How needlewomen bring the brows together

definitions.text: How needlewomen bring the brows together

parts.words: How needlewomen bring the brows together
parts.note: frowning is a way of drawing the eyebrows together; also what needlewomen do with wool

explanation.definitionFit: To furrow the brows is an idiom using the same verb as working wool with needles.

clue.text: A crowd get together

parts.note: a mass is a crowd

explanation.surface: A crowd gathers.
explanation.definitionFit: To accumulate or gather together.

clue.text: Spend time in idleness at agent's extravaganza

indicators.note: an extravaganza is a wild display, so the letters are thrown about

parts.note: the possessive s is kept as a letter here

explanation.surface: Lazing around at an agent's lavish show.
explanation.definitionFit: To be inactive and not develop means to stagnate.

clue.text: One's own 3-d player

parts.note: personal means belonging to oneself
stereo is short for stereoscopic, three-dimensional

explanation.surface: Someone owns a three-dimensional player.
explanation.walkthrough: A personal stereo is a portable music player like a Walkman.
explanation.definitionFit: A portable cassette or CD device is a music player.
